Need Some Help?
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I create a BS&A Online Account?
A step-by-step guide can be found here: Create an Account .
How do I claim my property as the property owner?
As a resident user, you can claim up to five properties at no charge. After searching for the desired property, select the Claim it as your property on the property's webpage.
How do I search for a parcel?
As a resident user, you can use the search bar on the BS&A Online homepage to search by Address, Name, and Parcel Number. Additionally, users can perform a Detailed Record Search where they can drill down further using application specific searches.
